title: Koebe uniformization, John domains, and transboundary modulus
summary: We prove Koebe's conjecture for John domains by showing that every planar John domain is conformally equivalent to a circle domain. Our proof is based on a geometric property of John domains, which we prove to be sufficient for uniformization by a circle domain. As a consequence, we obtain an alternative proof of Koebe's conjecture for inner uniform and Gromov hyperbolic domains, recovering results established in earlier work of the authors.
